post: Forget tiny plates. If your weekend social eating is just passing small dishes, you’re doing it wrong. Enter Xinjiang’s Da Pan Ji (big-plate chicken). 🍗 It’s literally a massive, spicy, potato-and-chicken mountain meant to be shared with the whole squad. Think Sunday roast vibes, but way more chaotic and fun. You just rip the fresh naan bread, dip it deep in the rich sauce, and bond. Who’s bringing the big appetites to the table? 🤤
